description: 1 when the cell is at or above the pool threshold. Applies the pool multiplier and splits the pool strip.

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High columns H onward, one per median target (score thresholds, then the GPA median)
description: Sign g of the cell for one median target: +1 at or above t, -1 below, 0 (or -1 under 'below') for unscored or blank-GPA cells. Every median margin and probability is a SUMPRODUCT over it.

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High columns after the median signs, one per percentile target
description: Sign of the cell for one percentile target, as for the median at that target's t. Weighted q and -(1 - q) in the percentile margin and probability.

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High column after the signs
description: The cell's yield floor (upper or lower group value). The yield column clips at it.

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High column after yield floor
description: The cell's yield cap (upper or lower group value). The yield column clips at it; the yield strip counts cells where it would bind.

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High column after yield cap
description: The cell's latest-cohort award, the point at which base yield is centered. The yield formula measures award changes from it.

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High column after a0
description: The cell's base yield for the sheet's case, from partial pooling. Starting point of the yield formula.

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High column after y0
description: Lowest history award in the cell (cohorts with admits). Lower end of the observed range for the evidence label.

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High column after award low
description: Highest history award in the cell. Upper end of the observed range for the evidence label.

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High column U
description: The cell's applications in the base cycle; the start of every scenario's applications.

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High block column 1
description: 1 when the cell belongs to the scenario's active segment. Applies the segment lift, segment incentive scope and segment shift, and selects the segment block's cells.

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High block column 2
description: 1 when the cell is in the incentive's scope and meets the minimum score. Only eligible cells receive the incentive.
formula: in scope (out-of-state, segment or none) x (score_lo >= bonus_min_score when set)

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High block column 3
description: Scenario applications: base applications times the pool multiplier for upper-group cells, times the segment lift for segment cells. Multiplied by the admit rate to give admits.
formula: apps_base x (pool_multiplier if upper) x (1 + segment_pool_lift_pct / 100 x in_seg); reproduce: rounded when round_apps_after_pool

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High block column 4
description: The scenario's admit rate for the cell, read from Levers.

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High block column 5
description: Applications times admit rate (rounded when integer admits are set). Multiplied by yield to give expected enrolled; the yield strip and shrink path work on it.
formula: applications x admit rate (ROUND when integer_admits)

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High block column 6
description: Award before any incentive: tuition on a full-tuition cell, otherwise the lever award (scaled by 1 + p when awards scale), capped at tuition.
formula: IF(full_tuition, T_s, MIN(award_usd x (1 + p if scaled), T_s))

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High block column 7
description: Award after incentive minus award before it: the incentive actually paid per enrollee, less than the bonus where the tuition cap binds. Feeds incentive cost and the incentive block.

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High block column 8
description: The award the cell's students receive: award before incentive plus the bonus where eligible, capped at tuition. Feeds yield, merit, the net tuition weight and the award matrix.
formula: MIN(award base + bonus_usd x eligible, T_s)

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High block column 9
description: The yield shift that applies to the cell: segment override, else residency override, else the global shift. Overrides replace, not add.
formula: IF(in_seg and segment override set, segment, IF(residency override set, residency, global))

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High block column 10
description: Enrollment probability per admit: base yield moved along the placeholder slope by the award change, clipped, shifted, clipped again. In reproduce mode, the loaded yield. Feeds expected enrolled and every variance.
formula: clip(clip(y0 + b/100 x (award - a0)/1000, floor, cap) + shift/100, floor, cap)

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High block column 11
description: observed when the award lies within the cell's observed award range plus the tolerance, else extrapolated. Describes how well the yield is known, never the award. Feeds the extrapolated share.

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High block column 12

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High block column 13

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High block column 14
description: Enrolled times award: merit dollars in the cell. Sums to merit.

excel_location: Ledger_Low/Middle/High block column 15
description: Net dollars per enrollee in the cell: tuition minus award minus the need rate. The NTR mean and variance, the incentive's NTR change and the pool strip's NTR read it.

excel_location: Ledger_Middle block columns after net tuition weight, one per tuition grid value (rows 4 and 5 hold T(p) and p)

dimensions: scenario x cell x grid value
formula: MIN(IF(full_tuition, T(p), MIN(award_usd x (1 + p if scaled), T(p))) + bonus x eligible, T(p))

excel_location: Response!K

excel_location: Response!L

description: Expected scored enrollees below a threshold. Feeds the margin, the variances and the percentile approximation flag.
formula: G- = sum over g = -1 of mu_c

description: Expected margin at t from mu (unrounded); equals the Summary margin when enrolled is not rounded.

Expected percentile margin with weights q at or above t and -(1 - q) below.
references: spec 5; MR 6; sw/risk.py cf_pct; spec 0A A1

description: Variance of the percentile margin.
formula: V_q = q^2 sum_above v + (1-q)^2 sum_below v + s^2 (q^2 G+^2 + (1-q)^2 G-^2 - 2 rho q (1-q) G+ G-)

description: Specialty aid plus the need departure: the constant subtracted from the sum of w x enrolled to give ntr_y1.
Variance of ntr_y1: binomial part weighted by w^2 plus the shock part. Gives the NTR range and probability.
formula: V_n = sum w^2 v + s^2 (sum w mu)^2

description: Mean M_S and variance V_S of segment enrolled over segment cells. Feed the segment range, normal-form probability and approximation flag.
formula: M_S = sum_S mu; V_S = sum_S v + s^2 M_S^2

description: Exact distribution of a sum of cell binomials mixed over the shock by 20-node Gauss-Hermite quadrature. Gives the static exact segment probability and checks the closed forms in tests.
formula: convolution of cell pmfs, averaged over shock nodes
references: spec 5; MR 6; sw/risk.py exact_pmf, segment_exact; MR 6.6

description: 1.645: the normal quantile for the 90% outcome ranges.
